data.description:
## Context
Story: 155a-6b7b-514f-44e8 — extend check-session-merge-only.sh to enforce merge-only when .debug-active is present

## Goal
Add 5 new RED tests to tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh covering .debug-active behavior. Append RED marker to .test-index.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh | modify | n/a | n/a |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh
2. Append 5 new test functions after the existing 4 tests, before print_summary:
   - test_debug_active_alone_rejects_non_merge:
     * Create temp git repo; touch .debug-active; NO .sprint-active
     * Run script → assert exit code != 0 (rejected)
   - test_debug_active_with_merge_commit_accepted:
     * Create temp git repo; touch .debug-active; write .git/MERGE_HEAD
     * Run script → assert exit 0 (merge commit accepted)
   - test_dso_debug_active_override_exits_0_and_writes_audit_log:
     * Create temp git repo; touch .debug-active; DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 and DSO_ARTIFACTS_DIR=<tmpdir>
     * Run script → assert exit 0; assert at least 1 file in DSO_ARTIFACTS_DIR (audit log)
   - test_both_markers_sprint_escape_only_still_rejects:
     * Create temp git repo; touch .sprint-active AND .debug-active; DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 ONLY
     * Run script → assert exit code != 0 (debug-active still blocks)
   - test_both_markers_both_escapes_accepted:
     * Create temp git repo; touch .sprint-active AND .debug-active; DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 AND DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0
     * Run script → assert exit 0 (both escape hatches cleared)
3. Add the 5 function calls in the run-all section with matching echo headers
4. Append RED marker to .test-index:
   plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh: [test_debug_active_alone_rejects_non_merge, test_debug_active_with_merge_commit_accepted, test_dso_debug_active_override_exits_0_and_writes_audit_log, test_both_markers_sprint_escape_only_still_rejects, test_both_markers_both_escapes_accepted]

## Acceptance Criteria
- tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh contains all 5 new test functions and run calls
- .test-index contains RED marker for check-session-merge-only.sh referencing all 5 new function names
- New tests FAIL (RED phase) — .debug-active not yet recognized by script
- Existing 4 sprint-active tests still run and pass (they are not modified)
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits non-zero; RED markers in .test-index mark expected failures
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
